driver_archetypes.rationale: Base car type from Saval et al. (Table 11); maintains low acceleration/deceleration to match observed small discharge headways (M1/car).
Car violators drawn from 'car' distribution; currently passive (p=0) to preserve population structure.
Base motorcycle type from Saval et al.; high share fills 'moto' distribution; low accel/decel matches M1/moto discharge headway.
Motorcycle violators drawn from 'moto' distribution; small share reserved for space-seeking behaviours.
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution 'moto_violator'); share set to 1.0 to fill the 'moto_violator' distribution; jmTimegapMinor defaults to 1.0 s.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M2/early/moto (observed share 0.1466); enables motorcycles to creep over the stop line in the last seconds of red to match observed early-start frequency.
Targets M3/share/moto (observed share ~0.076); Saval et al. report 50% chance for front-row motos to run red; k=0 disables swarm effect as per literature.
Targets M8/moto (observed wrong-lane share 0.2145); activates wrong-lane seeking when queues are long to match observed lateral displacement and blocking behaviour.
Targets observed field behaviour where most motorcycles squeeze past standing U-turners; high probability (0.9) reflects aggressive lateral maneuvering.
Targets conservative car behaviour; low probability (0.1) reflects rarity of cars changing lane to pass standing U-turners.
